cards.title: Driver
items: lib.rs runs the stages in order; main.rs starts it on a 64 MiB stack
args.rs parses the command line with clap; run.rs links into a private temporary directory and runs the program
fuzz.rs runs the check path on fuzz input, asserts spans and compiles clean input
generate/ writes a well-typed program from fuzz bytes; fuzz_program.rs builds it three ways, runs the builds and judges them (tests and the fuzz feature only)

mir::build lowers tir to mir, then infers borrowed parameters (params.rs), places moves (ownership.rs), hoists unique calls, elaborates scope releases (elaborate.rs) and removes retain/release pairs within a block (pairs.rs), and debug builds certify each function
sisu build --emit tokens|ast|tir|mir|ir|ir-raw stops early and prints
sisu check stops after the checker
--format json prints diagnostics as JSON Lines
sisu explain prints a code's explanation
sisu run builds and runs the program, passing it its arguments and exiting with its exit code
-O2 or -O3 runs LLVM's default<O2> or default<O3> pipeline
--rc-checks builds count checks into the program
--linker bfd|gold|lld|mold picks the linker cc runs
--allocator mimalloc|system picks the runtime archive it links

cards.title: Runtime
items: C ABI; the sisu-runtime library, which each of the two archives links; every program links one
sisu_print_int, sisu_print_bool, sisu_eprint_int, sisu_eprint_bool, sisu_flush_stdout
text.rs: sisu_print_char, sisu_print_str, sisu_eprint_*, sisu_str_compare, sisu_write_*, sisu_utf8_*, sisu_words_count, sisu_word_next
show.rs: sisu_show_*, the text sink that print and interpolation write compound values through
stdin.rs: sisu_read_line
args.rs: sisu_args_len, sisu_arg
sisu_panic, sisu_panic_message, sisu_panic_bounds
sisu_alloc, sisu_realloc, sisu_free for objects, arrays and strings
sisu_rc_fault, sisu_rc_check_exit under --rc-checks
